display_information.name: flaron-but-ooc
display_information.description: Use the "Get forward/OOC channel" shortcut in a message with a forward to show the channel of the forwarded message.
display_information.long_description: Use the "Get forward/OOC channel" shortcut in a message with a forward (eg an OOC message) to show the channel (ID is always shown, and name is also shown when known) where the forwarded message/s was/were sent. This also works for message links and mentioned channels.

shortcuts.name: Get forward/OOC channel
shortcuts.description: Reveal forwarded/OOC channel/DM ID and name
